title: Tuning my 48v48 Strategy war game with a headless client
author: Tom_Baron
selftext:
Not a gameplay shot!  
  
Absolutely in my element now, I got claude to build me a headless client which batch runs NPC vs NPC games for me batches of four up to 24 games, not only do I have a full suite of all my tuning levers behind this, I can customise distinct strategies into a batch of NPCs and run them against the control set to tone down meta. Worth building if you guys are making more complicated games.   


I've got a long way to go experimenting in this. There are some obvious issues just in this screenshot although most matches do end up closer than the one highlighted!
